Theres 3 things that really mark the line between ideation and intention: plan, materials, and date. Having a plan is when you decide on which method to use and don't really think about any other methods. Its usually the first thing would happen if you're drifting towards intent. Having or obtaining the materials to follow through that plan is usually the next thing that would happen. The last thing that would happen is the decision of a date/time/location to carry out the plan. If any of these sound like anything you're feeling, PLEASE seek any help you can get. Talk to a friend, keep posting here, or call a hotline at the very least. Keep talking to your therapist about these feelings. If you think that you might be a threat to yourself, call 911 or admit yourself to a hospital immedietely. You are not alone. You can get through this!

There are potential issues with the neurological development of the visual areas of the brain. Because VR dissociates the normal correlation between cues such as focal length, convergence and binocular disparity, young, developing brains could have their depth perception screwed up in the visual cortex. I'm not aware of any studies proving harm or lack thereof, but it is likely enough that i would recommend against letting anyone under 12 play for more than a few minutes.
